description: Main source file for a Zephyr-based network application implementing a SO_TXTIME client with network event handling, socket creation, and PTP clock integration.

methods.name: quit
methods.description: Signals the application to terminate by releasing a semaphore.

methods.name: event_handler
methods.description: Handles network management events such as DHCP, connection, and disconnection events, updating connection status and signaling the main thread.

methods.name: rx
methods.description: Receives data from the socket in a loop, logging received data size.

methods.name: tx
methods.description: Sends scheduled network packets with SO_TXTIME, updating transmission time based on PTP clock.

methods.name: get_local_ipv6
methods.description: Retrieves the local IPv6 source address for a given interface and peer address.

methods.name: get_local_ipv4
methods.description: Retrieves the local IPv4 source address for a given interface and peer address.

methods.name: create_socket
methods.description: Creates and configures a socket (UDP or raw packet) with SO_TXTIME and priority options.

methods.name: get_peer_address
methods.description: Parses and resolves the peer address, selecting appropriate network interface.

methods.name: set_qbv_params
methods.description: Configures Ethernet Qbv parameters for time-aware scheduling.

methods.name: cmd_sample_quit
methods.description: Command handler to set quit flag and signal application termination.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing network, creating threads, and managing application lifecycle.
